subject: Argumentation Mining
object: identify argumentative text from the non-argumentative text
source_sentence: The major tasks of argumentation mining include: 1) identify argumentative text from the non- argumentative text, 2) classify argumentation components (e.g., Major Claim, Claims, Premise, etc.) in the text, 3) determine the relationships between the different components, and 4) classify the relationships as supporting, attacking, or neutral.
